create_slab_from_bulk_random: create a Slab object by randomly sampling a slab surface from a Bulk structure with max Miller index
create_slabs_from_specific_millers: create Slab objects for specific Miller indices from a Bulk structure using from_bulk_get_specific_millers
enumerate_all_slabs: enumerate all symmetrically distinct slabs from a bulk structure up to a given max Miller index
tag_and_tile_slab_atoms: tag surface atoms and tile a slab structure to a minimum lateral dimension using tile_and_tag_atoms
standardize_bulk_structure: standardize a bulk unit cell to its conventional standard structure using standardize_bulk
